title: Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
AADI SOLVENT RECYCLERS PRIVATE LIMITED operates in the solvent recycling and waste management sector, focusing on the recovery and reuse of industrial solvents. The organization supports manufacturing and processing businesses by helping them improve resource efficiency and reduce environmental impact. The company emphasizes operational reliability, regulatory compliance, and long-term client relationships. Team members are encouraged to contribute to sustainable practices and continuous improvement in service quality.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Account Manager role based in Meerut. The Account Manager will oversee day-to-day client relationships, acting as the primary contact for assigned accounts and ensuring timely resolution of client inquiries and issues. Responsibilities include managing account portfolios, tracking orders and deliveries, coordinating with operations and logistics teams, and monitoring contract terms to support service quality and compliance. The role involves preparing account reports, analyzing customer data, identifying opportunities for upselling or cross-selling, and supporting pricing and negotiation discussions. The Account Manager will also collaborate with internal stakeholders to improve processes, maintain accurate documentation, and support business development activities within the solvent recycling and waste management domain.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management and customer service skills, with the ability to handle multiple accounts and priorities.
* Proficiency in basic business administration tasks, including reporting, documentation, and use of office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, CRM software).
* Solid communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across sales, operations, and logistics teams.
* Analytical and problem-solving abilities to interpret account data, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Management, or a related field; relevant experience in account management, sales, or customer success is preferred.
* Understanding of industrial operations, manufacturing, or waste management sectors is an advantage; willingness to learn solvent recycling processes and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to work on-site in Meerut, maintain a structured work approach, and uphold high standards of professionalism and ethical conduct.

title: Senior Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
APAC Financial Services Private Limited is a tech-led Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), registered with the Reserve Bank of India in 2018, focused on lending to MSMEs in semi-urban and rural markets across Bharat. The company is backed by reputed investors including Multiples Alternate Asset Management, Norwest Venture Partners, Creador, and HNIs, with a consolidated net worth of around INR 1,100 crores. APAC operates a 200+ branch network across 6 states and 1 Union Territory, sourcing customers directly through its on-ground presence and proprietary “Alpha” origination and underwriting technology platform. With more than 45,000 customers, over 2,300 employees, and consistently high customer satisfaction scores, APAC is on a strong growth trajectory. The organization emphasizes “Growth with Quality & Profitability,” supported by experienced leadership and scalable physical and digital infrastructure.
  
**Role Description**
  
The Senior Relationship Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Bulandshahr, responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of MSME clients. The role involves sourcing new customers, conducting needs-based financial assessments, and recommending appropriate lending solutions aligned with APAC’s credit policies. The Senior Relationship Manager will maintain strong, long-term client relationships through regular meetings, follow-ups, and post-disbursement support to ensure high customer satisfaction and portfolio quality. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with credit, operations, and collections teams, ensuring timely documentation and disbursement, monitoring account performance, and addressing client queries or issues promptly. The role also requires adherence to regulatory and internal compliance standards, accurate reporting, and contribution to branch-level business growth targets.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and customer service skills, with the ability to build trust and sustain long-term client partnerships.
* Experience in MSME lending or retail/business banking, including credit assessment, documentation, and portfolio monitoring.
* Solid understanding of financial products, basic credit concepts, and risk management practices relevant to NBFCs and MSME customers.
* Proficiency in using digital tools and lending platforms; comfort working in a tech-enabled, process-driven environment.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain financial solutions clearly and handle client objections.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities to evaluate customer needs and business viability.
* Ability to work on-site in Bulandshahr, travel locally as needed, and collaborate closely with branch and regional teams.
* Graduate degree in Commerce, Finance, Business, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification or MBA is an advantage.
* Prior experience in semi-urban or rural markets

title: Relationship Manager - JLG
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Role/ Job Title:**
Relationship Manager-JLG
  
  
**Function/ Department**
: JLG
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
'The role entails deepening relationships with Banking accounts and ensuring best in-class service to the customers. The role bearer has a responsibility to identify prospective customers and convert them into real business opportunities. The role bearer is responsible for creating Joint Liability Groups and centres and managing them through the formation, disbursal and collection phases while managing a team to drive client acquisition, building household level customer relationships and capitalizing on lifetime value in each relationship.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
'
  
  

* Deepen existing portfolio to ensure customer stickiness.
* Manage zoning activity to map household needs in villages and areas allocated.
* Conduct end-user checks as specified post disbursal of loans while achieving monthly and annual group loan booking targets.
* Assess and evaluate the client needs and generate new sources of revenue by leveraging cross sell opportunities as per their lifestyle, risk profiling and requirements.
* Contribute to penetration of liabilities business in new markets through lead generations and account opening as per needs of customer.
* Achieve individual and branch sales goals through new business sales, referrals and retention of account relationship.
* Monitor high collections efficiency through discipline and drive.
* Conduct field audits and customer verifications to ensure high quality of accounts.
* Gather Latest Market intelligence and track and benchmark against best practices in competitor banks.
* Evaluate the growth strategy based on competitor analysis and feedback from different channels/customers.
* Recommend process changes to improve service efficiency and quality across the branch network.
* Manage a team of field officers, taking responsibility of their development and attrition.

**Secondary Responsibilities:**
'Develop and implement livelihood advancement and community development initiatives.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
Graduate
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
5+ years of relevant banking experience.
